column1: # mg-223d -- PINS.tsv.  THE DECLARATION, and the input to the R4 control.
# One row per QUOTED HEX LITERAL in tracked `*.py`/`*.sh` that resolves to a
# commit that is NOT an ancestor of `main`.  These are DEPENDENCES: the object
# must still be there or the instrument does not run.  They are not endorsements
# and the tag prefix `pin/` says only that something pins the commit.
# THE UNIT IS THE TOKEN, NOT THE COMMIT.  `3738079` and `37380799` are two rows
# and one commit; both are true of different things and conflating them is the
# grain defect this arc keeps finding.  R4 prints both counts.
# COLUMNS:  short <TAB> full <TAB> keep-alive-tag <TAB> pinning code/* dirs <TAB> note
